# Fallout 76: Burning Springs Starter Bundle (All Offers)

![Fallout 76: Burning Springs Starter Bundle (All Offers)](/uploads/596_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

[Update 12/04/2025] Updated Mun-O-Matik description and intervals

With the new Burning Springs update from December 2nd, 2025, a new bundle will now be released. This is now a little slimmer than the €30 bundles.

## Bundle content

- 800 atoms (+300 bonus)
- Ulysses Outfit & Headwear Set
- Plus Mun-O-Matik ammunition collector set

## Mun-O-Matik ammo collector

Description:

The Mun-O-Matik generates ammo over time so you can spend more time shooting and less time crafting.

Each Mun-O-Matik variant produces a single ammunition type: shotshells, 10mm, .44, .45, .308, or 5.56.

This item cannot be built in a shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS WILL BE DISPLAYED IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

Unlike other collectors, a collector can be set up for each type of ammunition. In total only 1 per CAMP. So you can choose a type that you want to collect. This then collects ammunition for you at significantly shorter intervals than usual.

Collect one of these species:

| *quantity* | *type* | *Interval* | *Maximum* | 
| 4-8 | **Shotshells** | 12.6 sec | 40 | 
| 6-10 | **10mm** | 12.96 sec | 60 | 
| 4-8 | **.44** | 5.76 sec | 42 | 
| 15-17 | **.45** | 4.68 sec | 60 | 
| 3-6 | **.308** | 2.16 sec | 30 | 
| 3-7 | **5.56** | 17.28 sec | 80 |
